result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are visible truncation issues on horizontally scrolling content and a typo in the search placeholder. No critical blockers are apparent.

issues.description: Horizontally scrolling sections are clipped at the right edge: the category chips after “Healthy” and the “Trattoria Piccol…” restaurant card are cut off, making content look broken or overflowing.
issues.suggestion: Add clear carousel affordances such as peek spacing, scroll indicators, arrows, or ensure cards/chips fit within safe viewport padding.

issues.description: Search placeholder text appears misspelled as “Restarants, dishes, groceries” instead of “Restaurants…”.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.

issues.description: Small green metadata text such as “€0 delivery” and “See all” may have limited contrast and readability for some users.
issues.suggestion: Verify contrast ratios and increase font weight/size or darken the green where needed.
